label: MPC80
note: Up to 40 %, 60–70 % and 80 % or more protein are called low, medium and high protein powders; the US has no standard of identity for MPC (US Dairy Export Council technical report, seen in a search summary)

about.text: A milk protein concentrate named for its protein: at least 79.5 % of the powder is milk protein, the rest mostly lactose (under 9 %), ash (under 8 %) and fat (under 2.5 %). Casein and whey proteins stay at about 80:20, as in milk. Mostly used in beverages and bars, and as a replacement for skim milk powder or caseinate where more protein is needed.

links.name: U.S. Dairy Export Council: Milk protein concentrate (MPC 80)

how.text: Ultrafiltration and diafiltration capture essentially all the casein and whey proteins of the skim milk; the more diafiltration, the higher the protein, which is what takes a concentrate to 80 %.
